scope: Official advisory/source review only; no exploit, build or regression execution. Applicability is separated by Node/static deployment mode.
head: 7ac93ead9154ba28e1a325979b4cc73a75910e99
benefitScope: Three code/configuration matches for self-hosted Next server mode. Not three demonstrated exploits and not a benefit attributed to Python-only static serving.

sourceFacts.routers: web/pages routes; web/app contains only chat-context.tsx and i18n.ts, with no App Router entry files
sourceFacts.auth: next-auth declared but no imports, handlers, withAuth or authorization Middleware in either tracked tree
sourceFacts.proxy: Both next.config.js files rewrite /api/v1/:path* to literal http://127.0.0.1:5670/api/v1/:path*
sourceFacts.images: images.unoptimized: true in both inspected versions
sourceFacts.i18n: Client-side i18next only; no Next config i18n
sourceFacts.data: No page-level getServerSideProps; prompt route getStaticProps/getStaticPaths with fallback blocking; custom Document.getInitialProps
sourceFacts.unused: No Server Actions, PPR, Cache Components, beforeInteractive or next/og ImageResponse found
sourceFacts.serving: Next Node server mode and Python StaticFiles export mode must be distinguished

advisories.representativeFix: 13.4.20-canary.13 (first published fix; included in later stable lines)
advisories.impact: Missing cache-control on empty prefetch responses can let a CDN cache an unusable response.
advisories.applicability: Unconfirmed, not counted: 13.4.7 is in range, but the required empty-prefetch/CDN caching deployment is not established. The official upstream fix is PR #54732, commit 20d05958ff853e9c9e42139ffec294336881c648.

advisories.impact: Server Action redirects can induce server-side requests to an attacker-controlled destination.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use Server Actions.

advisories.impact: Ambiguous HTTP request boundaries on rewritten routes can poison the response queue.
advisories.applicability: Applies to the self-hosted Next server path: 13.4.7 is affected and both inspected versions proxy /api/v1/:path* through rewrites. Static files served only by Python do not use this path. Exploitability behind a particular ingress was not tested.

advisories.impact: Crafted requests can crash the Next server and deny service.
advisories.applicability: Applies to the Next server path: 13.4.7 is in the affected range and the official advisory does not require App Router or another optional feature. A Python-only static deployment does not run this Next server.

advisories.impact: A non-dynamic Pages Router SSR response can be incorrectly marked cacheable.
advisories.applicability: Not a 13.4.7 upgrade benefit: the impact description starts at 13.5.1. Pages Router alone is insufficient; no page-level getServerSideProps implementation was found.

advisories.impact: Image optimization can consume excessive CPU and deny service.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: built-in Image Optimization is disabled with images.unoptimized: true in both versions; the advisory explicitly excludes this setting.

advisories.impact: Path-based authorization in Middleware can be bypassed.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not implement Next Middleware authorization; a next-auth dependency declaration does not establish that usage.

advisories.impact: Server Action requests can remain open and consume connection capacity.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use Server Actions.

advisories.impact: A crafted internal header can bypass authorization performed in Middleware.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: no middleware, proxy authorization entry or next-auth/middleware usage exists in either inspected version.

advisories.impact: Middleware subrequest identifiers can leak to external hosts.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use Next Middleware subrequests.

advisories.impact: A race between page/data requests can poison a CDN cache with the wrong response body.
advisories.applicability: Unconfirmed, not counted: Pages Router is present, but the required CDN/cache misconfiguration is not established. Official sources disagree on the affected version wording; see the source notes.

advisories.impact: Missing development-server origin checks can expose source information to a malicious site.
advisories.applicability: Not counted: the GHSA scopes source exposure to App Router, which this project does not route through. Vercel also describes development-script inclusion; that separate exposure was not verified. The candidate explicitly configures allowedDevOrigins.

advisories.representativeFix: 15.2.0 is the GHSA safe stable boundary; see source note on 15.1.8
advisories.impact: A cached HTTP 204 response can deny access to a page under particular ISR/CDN conditions.
advisories.applicability: Not a 13.4.7 upgrade benefit: the affected versions are on the 15.x line. The required ISR/CDN conditions were not established either.

advisories.impact: Missing Vary behavior can let a cache serve RSC payloads in place of HTML.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC responses; 13.4.7 is also outside the stated 15.3.x range.

advisories.impact: Reflecting request headers through Middleware can cause server-side request forgery.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not implement Middleware or pass incoming headers to NextResponse.next(). Its fixed rewrites rule is a different feature.

advisories.impact: External image sources can trigger downloads with attacker-controlled content or names.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: built-in Image Optimization is disabled and neither images.domains nor remotePatterns is configured.

advisories.impact: An image cache key can confuse responses that vary by authentication headers.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: built-in Image Optimization is disabled; no authenticated image API route is present in the inspected source.

advisories.impact: Unsafe RSC deserialization can permit remote code execution.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC. Official guidance also explicitly excludes Next 13.x and Pages Router. CVE-2025-66478 is the downstream Next.js tracking ID, not a second counted benefit.

advisories.impact: RSC deserialization can hang the server and consume CPU.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC. Later incomplete-fix advisories remain separate rows below.

advisories.impact: App Router requests can expose compiled Server Function source.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router or Server Functions.

advisories.impact: An incomplete RSC DoS fix leaves additional payloads able to trigger an infinite loop.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC.

advisories.impact: Oversized remote images can exhaust Image Optimizer memory.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: built-in Image Optimization is disabled and remotePatterns is not configured.

advisories.impact: PPR resume buffering or decompression can exhaust memory in minimal mode.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router PPR or Cache Components.

advisories.impact: RSC payloads can cause excessive CPU use, memory exhaustion or a server crash.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC.

advisories.impact: Chunked requests through external rewrites can desynchronize proxy/backend request boundaries.
advisories.applicability: Applies to the self-hosted Next proxy shape: the fixed loopback backend is external to Next's router and 13.4.7 is affected. A constant hostname does not remove request-boundary ambiguity. Static-only serving and CDN-handled rewrites are different deployment paths; no exploit was attempted.

advisories.impact: PPR resume bodies can be buffered without a size bound outside minimal mode.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router PPR or Cache Components; 13.4.7 also predates the affected 16.1.x path.

advisories.impact: An opaque Origin can bypass internal dev-endpoint origin protections.
advisories.applicability: Not a 13.4.7 upgrade benefit: the affected range starts at 16.0.1. The candidate uses allowedDevOrigins and already includes this fix.

advisories.impact: Opaque-origin requests can bypass Server Action CSRF checks.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use Server Actions; 13.4.7 also predates the stated affected range.

advisories.impact: Unbounded image-variant cache growth can exhaust disk storage.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project disables the built-in Image Optimization endpoint; existing build-directory disk usage is not evidence of this vulnerability.

advisories.impact: RSC Server Function payloads can cause excessive CPU consumption.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC.

advisories.impact: Additional RSC payloads can deny service through excessive CPU consumption.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC.

advisories.impact: Internal data headers can turn Middleware redirects into unusable cached redirects.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use Middleware/proxy redirects. Its Next config rewrites are not authorization/redirect Middleware.

advisories.impact: Locale-less Pages data routes can bypass Middleware authorization.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: there is no Next Middleware authorization or Next config i18n. Client-side i18next translations do not enable Next's i18n routing.

advisories.impact: Dynamic route parameter injection can bypass Middleware checks.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use Middleware authorization; 13.4.7 is also below the affected 15.4.x start.

advisories.impact: App Router transport variants can evade Middleware matching.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router or Middleware authorization.

advisories.impact: RSC header interpretation can poison shared response caches.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC responses.

advisories.impact: Crafted WebSocket upgrades can make a self-hosted Next server proxy arbitrary destinations.
advisories.applicability: Not a 13.4.7 upgrade benefit: the affected range begins at 13.4.13. The self-hosted server shape is relevant, but the old pinned version is outside the range and 16.3.0 includes the fix.

advisories.impact: Large local images can exhaust Image Optimizer memory.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: images.unoptimized is true; the advisory explicitly excludes this configuration.

advisories.impact: Cache Components/Server Action requests can deadlock and exhaust connections.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use Cache Components, PPR or Server Actions.

advisories.impact: Untrusted content in beforeInteractive scripts can escape serialization and execute script.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use next/script beforeInteractive or supply untrusted data to that feature.

advisories.impact: RSC cache-busting collisions can poison shared response variants.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/RSC responses.

advisories.impact: Malformed CSP nonces in App Router responses can enable cached cross-site scripting.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router nonce-based rendering.

advisories.impact: The segment-prefetch authorization fix was incomplete for Turbopack Middleware.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project uses Pages Router and Webpack, with no Middleware authorization.

advisories.impact: Server Action requests can exhaust CPU in App Router applications.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router/Server Actions; the advisory explicitly excludes Pages Router.

advisories.impact: A single-locale App Router/Turbopack setup can bypass Middleware authorization.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project uses Pages Router/Webpack and has no Next i18n or authorization Middleware.

advisories.impact: Public client artifacts can reveal internal Server Function endpoint identifiers.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router Server Actions or use-cache endpoints.

advisories.impact: Request-controlled hostname segments in rewrites/redirects can cause SSRF or open redirects.
advisories.applicability: Not affected by this specific advisory: both versions use the literal hostname 127.0.0.1:5670. Only the path is dynamic; the project does not use request-controlled destination hostnames.

advisories.impact: Malicious remote image/SVG metadata can exhaust Image Optimizer CPU.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: built-in Image Optimization is disabled and remotePatterns is absent; the advisory explicitly excludes unoptimized images.

advisories.impact: Edge-runtime Server Action payloads can consume unbounded memory.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use App Router Server Actions or Edge Server Actions.

advisories.impact: Mismatched server fetch request/init bodies can return another request's cached response.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project uses Pages Router, which the advisory explicitly excludes; browser Axios requests are not this server fetch cache.

advisories.impact: Non-UTF-8 server fetch bodies can collide in the response cache and disclose data.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project uses Pages Router, which the advisory explicitly excludes.

advisories.impact: Host-controlled Server Action forwarding on custom servers can cause SSRF.
advisories.applicability: Not affected: this project does not use Server Actions or their forwarding/redirect path.

advisories.impact: Pages/App Router servers on Windows filesystems can allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
advisories.applicability: Outside the requested fixed-by-16.3.0 set, and unresolved in this candidate. The recorded Windows Next server deployment matches the stated conditions; both 13.4.7 and 16.3.0 are affected. Python-only static serving is a different path. No exploit was run.

advisories.impact: AVIF processing through the Image Optimizer can trigger upstream remote code execution.
advisories.applicability: Outside the interval, not an upgrade benefit. Not affected in this project because built-in Image Optimization is disabled.

advisories.impact: Attacker-controlled SVG input to Node next/og ImageResponse can trigger remote code execution.
advisories.applicability: Outside the interval, not an upgrade benefit. Not affected in this project because next/og ImageResponse is not used.
